title: Fei-Fei Li joins AMD! World Labs officially merges in to expand into 3D world models and robotics AI
excerpt: AMD announced on November 16 that it has completed its acquisition of AI model company World Labs, further expanding its presence in the AI technology stack. Wo
content_html:
AMD announced on November 16 that it has completed its acquisition of AI model company World Labs, further expanding its presence in the AI technology stack. World Labs co-founder Fei-Fei Li will join AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to Chair and CEO Lisa Su.

World Labs focuses on developing AI models that can generate, reconstruct, and simulate interactive 3D environments, while also working on robotics learning and simulation technologies. After the acquisition, the World Labs team will continue to advance foundation model research and collaborate with AMD engineers to integrate model research findings into the development of next-generation AI infrastructure, supporting customers and developers in the open AI ecosystem.

Lisa Su said that infrastructure for the next-generation superintelligence era will require co-optimization of computing platforms and AI models. World Labs' accumulated research in foundation models will help AMD further plan the future direction of its hardware, software, and systems, and help AI researchers and developers expand the boundaries of technical capability.

This acquisition marks AMD's further extension toward the coordinated development of AI models and computing infrastructure, as it seeks to strengthen its competitiveness in the next-generation AI industry ecosystem by integrating model R&D capabilities.
